object: Xuanmen tidal connection / modern Xuanmen Project footprint
userHistoricalConstraint: In the target historical state the Xuanmen water system is open and connected; later reclamation, enclosure, dam and reservoir state must not survive.

modernEngineeringEvidence.role: dates and locates later Xuanmen engineering closure; not used as a substitute for the user's historical map
modernEngineeringEvidence.statement: After Phase I the channel between eastern Yueqing Bay and Xuanmen Bay was fully blocked; the study models 1975 as the pre-project state.

modernEngineeringEvidence.role: independent evidence that the Xuanmen project connected Yuhuan Island and created later reclamation/reservoir state
modernEngineeringEvidence.statement: The Xuanmen project constructed a dam to connect Yuhuan Island, created more than 7000 ha of farmland, and established a reservoir.

runtimeRule.reason: The modern project/dam must not remain as a land bridge in the 1940s state. The corridor guarantees topological connectivity while finer historical maps will later refine exact shoreline shape.

truthBoundary.topology: hard constraint for the current 1940s candidate
truthBoundary.exactShoreline: derived and provisional until finer user-provided historical maps replace it
truthBoundary.terrainElevation: mountain/island elevation is preserved independently from the open-water corridor unless the corridor explicitly crosses later engineering fill
